environment.gpu: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 4060 Laptop GPU (8 GiB)

observations: Short 2B feature-extraction smoke completed all four small splits.
Standalone BF16 and FP32 CUDA forward/backward stress passed, including a 4 GiB resident allocation.
Both longer Qwen workloads later failed with CUDA errors and contemporaneous Windows nvlddmkm events; the 2B retry advanced past the first failure point before a later TDR reset.
Windows event groups occurred at 10:57:49, 11:00:45, 11:03:33, 11:10:09, and 11:19:12-15 local time; event IDs included 13 and 153.
limitation: Event correlation does not establish whether the root cause is hardware, driver, power, WSL, or a model kernel. Passing standalone CUDA stress does not establish sustained model stability.
